newsitem.title: GERMANY: VW, Germany's IG Metall reach wage deal.
newsitem.headline: VW, Germany's IG Metall reach wage deal.

text.p: Germany's IG Metall said on Wednesday that about 90,000 workers at carmaker Volkswagen AG will receive a 1.5 percent pay raise effective August 1 as part of a new wage deal reached with the carmaker.
VW and IG Metall agreed to the deal late on Tuesday night that also calls for a 2.5 percent wage increase on August 1, 1998, the German union said.
In addition, the deal calls for all VW workers to receive a 500 mark bonus for 1997 and for a deal on part-time hours for older workers.
The Wolfsburg-based carmaker and IG Metall also reached a deal on the issue of Saturday work hours under which those working on Saturday will receive additional benefits.
